name: E2B
summary: E2B runs AI-generated code in isolated Linux sandboxes backed by Firecracker microVMs, controlled through Python and JavaScript/TypeScript SDKs. Sandboxes can be paused, which saves filesystem and memory, and resumed later. The runtime is Apache-2.0 and can be self-hosted, or used as a hosted cloud service.
facts: Pause saves filesystem and memory; kept until killed
Hobby $0 + usage ($100 one-time credit); Pro $150/month + usage
E2B Embed and Terraform deployment on AWS, GCP, Azure or Linux
goodFor: Running untrusted agent code with VM-level isolation
Code-interpreter style tools in Python or TypeScript
Teams that may later self-host the runtime
watchOut: Session length capped by plan (1 h on Hobby)
